description: Sent on request with the most recent events of the zone.
note: Words 6 onward hold Record Count records of two words each (Table 5-7b). The dictionary format has no repeated group, so the records are not decoded and declared_bits covers the fixed part only.

message_id.description: Identifies the message. See Table 5-1 and Table 6-1.

message_length.description: Length of the message in 16-bit words.

sequence_number.description: Incremented by the sender for each message; wraps from 1023 to 0.

time_of_day.description: Milliseconds since local midnight when the message was built.

record_count.description: Number of event records that follow, 0 to 20.
